Le département d'ingénierie (EN) fait avancer les limites de la technologie afin que les physiciens puissent effectuer leurs recherches. Au sein du département EN, le groupe Cooling and Ventilation (EN-CV) est responsable de la conception, de la construction, de l'exploitation et de l'entretien des installations de refroidissement et de ventilation pour les grands accélérateurs de physique de l'énergie, les expériences et les installations techniques. Le groupe EN-CV poursuit des systèmes de refroidissement et de ventilation durables qui améliorent les économies d'énergie et la récupération.

Vous rejoindrez la Section des méthodes, des magasins et de l'électricité (CES), qui supervise le fonctionnement et l'entretien des systèmes de traitement de l'eau, ainsi que le développement des procédures de maintenance, la mise en œuvre de la gestion informatisée de la maintenance (CMMS), la gestion de la documentation, la gestion des magasins de pièces de rechange et les travaux électriques.

Êtes-vous qualifié, proactif et spécialisé dans les systèmes industriels de traitement de l'eau, prêt à contribuer à un environnement de travail unique au cœur de l'une des installations scientifiques les plus complexes au monde?

Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez à l'analyse, à l'optimisation et au développement des systèmes de traitement de l'eau utilisés pour les installations de refroidissement et de ventilation. Vous assurerez la performance du système, la fiabilité et la conformité aux exigences environnementales et de sécurité, tout en soutenant les activités d'exploitation et de maintenance.
Fonctions

• Étudier, concevoir et valider les performances des nouvelles installations de traitement de l'eau ou améliorer les installations existantes de traitement de l'eau.

• Contribuer à la gestion du contrat de traitement de l'eau, produire des spécifications techniques et tous les documents pour la procédure d'appel d'offres pour le renouvellement du contrat.

• Diriger les enquêtes techniques et l'analyse des causes profondes des problèmes complexes ou récurrents touchant les systèmes de traitement de l'eau.

• Planifier, coordonner et superviser les activités de maintenance préventive et corrective (en utilisant le système CMMS), définir les stratégies appropriées et assurer l'alignement sur les besoins opérationnels.

• Surveiller le rendement du système et assurer le suivi des activités, en faisant rapport sur les progrès, le calendrier et les coûts.

• Coordination technique des activités d'entretien et d'installation des entrepreneurs, en veillant au respect des clauses contractuelles, des normes techniques et des exigences de sécurité.

• Veiller à ce que la documentation technique soit complète, structurée et à jour, conformément aux normes de qualité.

jobs.description:
Introduction
 You will ensure the availability and reliability of CERN's cryogenic installations by providing daily technical support, maintaining industrial instrumentation systems and diagnosing complex electrical faults. You will also contribute to the design and optimisation of low-voltage electrical cabinets and components, in compliance with electrical safety standards.
 Functions

• Contribute to the technical design and development of electrical cabinets for cryogenic systems, including the calculation to dimension the electrical systems, producing detailed electrical drawings, selecting components and ensuring compliance with electrical safety requirements.

• Participate in and supervise the fabrication, installation and commissioning of electrical and instrumentation systems for cryogenic installations, including related procurement activities such as evaluating cost estimates and ordering component.

• Provide daily operational support for cryogenic installations and contribute to the stand-by duty service to resolve urgent issues (including fault-finding, implementation of fixes, and reporting to the operation team).

• Plan and coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance activities for system components, setting maintenance priorities and keep the corresponding technical documentation and procedures up to date.

• Select and implement industrial instrumentation systems and carry out equipment testing and calibration according to operational requirements.

Technical certificate or general secondary education or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Industrial Electrotechnics, Electrical and Instrumentation Technology, Electromechanics or a related field.

Experience:

• Experience in the design of low-voltage electrical systems and cabinets, including system architecture, cable and protection sizing, device selection and preparation of wiring diagrams, using electrical SEE CAD software.

• Experience in the manufacture, wiring, testing, coordination of installation and commissioning of electrical equipment.

• Experience in diagnosing and resolving electrical or instrumentation faults in operational systems.

• Experience in preventive and corrective maintenance and in maintaining technical documentation and procedures.
 Technical competencies:

• Design and modelling of low-voltage electrical circuits and networks.

• Design of electromechanical systems.

• Operation and maintenance of electromechanical equipment and systems.

• Knowledge and application of instrumentation and measurement techniques, ideally in a process or cryogenic environment.
 Behavioural competencies:

• Managing Self: working well autonomously; taking on activities and tasks without prompting.

• Solving Problems: finding the information needed to solve problems; making objective judgements based on all the facts available.

• Communicating Effectively: delivering presentations in a structured and clear way; adjusting style and content to the audience; responding calmly and confidently to questions.

• Working in Teams: contributing to promoting a positive atmosphere in the team through an optimistic and constructive attitude; addressing issues.

• Learning and Sharing Knowledge: sharing knowledge and expertise freely and willingly with others; coaching others to ensure knowledge transfer.

 Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione
Garantirai la disponibilità e l'affidabilità delle installazioni criogeniche del CERN fornendo supporto tecnico giornaliero, mantenendo i sistemi di strumentazione industriale e diagnosticando complessi difetti elettrici. Contribuirai anche alla progettazione e ottimizzazione di armadi elettrici a bassa tensione e componenti, nel rispetto degli standard di sicurezza elettrica.
Funzioni

• Contribuisci alla progettazione tecnica e allo sviluppo di armadi elettrici per sistemi criogenici, compreso il calcolo alla dimensione dei sistemi elettrici, producendo disegni elettrici dettagliati, selezionando componenti e garantendo il rispetto dei requisiti di sicurezza elettrica.

• Partecipare e supervisionare la fabbricazione, l'installazione e la messa in servizio di sistemi elettrici e strumentali per impianti criogenici, comprese le relative attività di approvvigionamento, come la valutazione delle stime dei costi e componenti di ordinazione.

• Fornire supporto operativo giornaliero per installazioni criogeniche e contribuire al servizio di stand-by per risolvere problemi urgenti (compreso il rilevamento di guasti, l'implementazione di correzioni e la segnalazione al team operativo).

• Pianificare e coordinare le attività di manutenzione preventiva e correttiva per i componenti del sistema, impostare le priorità di manutenzione e mantenere la documentazione tecnica e le procedure corrispondenti fino ad oggi.

• Selezionare e implementare sistemi di strumentazione industriale e eseguire test e calibrazione delle attrezzature in base alle esigenze operative.

Certificato tecnico o istruzione secondaria generale o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo dell'elettrotecnica industriale, tecnologia elettrica e strumentazione, elettromeccanica o un campo correlato.

Esperienza:

• Esperienza nella progettazione di sistemi elettrici a bassa tensione e armadi, tra cui architettura di sistema, dimensionamento cavi e protezione, selezione dei dispositivi e preparazione dei diagrammi di cablaggio, utilizzando il software elettrico SEE CAD.

• Esperienza nella fabbricazione, cablaggio, collaudo, coordinamento di installazione e messa in servizio di apparecchiature elettriche.

• Esperienza nella diagnosi e nella risoluzione di guasti elettrici o strumentali nei sistemi operativi.

• Esperienza nella manutenzione preventiva e correttiva e nel mantenimento della documentazione tecnica e delle procedure.
Competenze tecniche:

• Progettazione e modellazione di circuiti elettrici a bassa tensione e reti.

• Progettazione di sistemi elettromeccanici.

• Funzionamento e manutenzione di apparecchiature e sistemi elettromeccanici.

• Conoscenza e applicazione delle tecniche di strumentazione e misura, idealmente in un processo o in un ambiente criogenico.
Competenze comportamentali:

• Gestire il Sé: lavorare bene autonomamente; intraprendere attività e attività senza richiedere.

• Risolvere i problemi: trovare le informazioni necessarie per risolvere i problemi; fare giudizi oggettivi basati su tutti i fatti disponibili.

• Comunicare efficacemente: fornire presentazioni in modo strutturato e chiaro; regolare lo stile e il contenuto al pubblico; rispondere con calma e con fiducia alle domande.

• Lavorare in team: contribuire a promuovere un'atmosfera positiva nel team attraverso un atteggiamento ottimista e costruttivo; affrontare i problemi.

• Conoscenza e condivisione: condividere conoscenze e competenze liberamente e volentieri con gli altri; allenare gli altri per garantire il trasferimento delle conoscenze.
Capacità linguistiche:
Parlato e scritto inglese o francese, con un impegno per imparare l'altra lingua.

Ammissibilità e chiusura:
La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati.
Questa vacanza sarà riempita il prima possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 30.09.2026 a 23:59 CEST .

Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (5 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato.
Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana
Flessibilità del lavoro: completamente in loco
Questa posizione comporta:

• Partecipazione ad un regolare servizio di stand-by, comprese le notti, la domenica e le festività ufficiali.

• Lavoro nelle aree di radiazione.

• Interventi in impianti sotterranei.

Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile!
Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano.
Ogni giorno, affrontiamo nuove sfide e opportunità entusiasmanti per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction
You will ensure the availability and reliability of CERN's cryogenic installations by providing daily technical support, maintaining industrial instrumentation systems and diagnosing complex electrical faults. You will also contribute to the design and optimisation of low-voltage electrical cabinets and components, in compliance with electrical safety standards.
Functions

• Contribute to the technical design and development of electrical cabinets for cryogenic systems, including the calculation to dimension the electrical systems, producing detailed electrical drawings, selecting components and ensuring compliance with electrical safety requirements.

• Participate in and supervise the fabrication, installation and commissioning of electrical and instrumentation systems for cryogenic installations, including related procurement activities such as evaluating cost estimates and ordering component.

• Provide daily operational support for cryogenic installations and contribute to the stand-by duty service to resolve urgent issues (including fault-finding, implementation of fixes, and reporting to the operation team).

• Plan and coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance activities for system components, setting maintenance priorities and keep the corresponding technical documentation and procedures up to date.

• Select and implement industrial instrumentation systems and carry out equipment testing and calibration according to operational requirements.

Technical certificate or general secondary education or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Industrial Electrotechnics, Electrical and Instrumentation Technology, Electromechanics or a related field.

Experience:

• Experience in the design of low-voltage electrical systems and cabinets, including system architecture, cable and protection sizing, device selection and preparation of wiring diagrams, using electrical SEE CAD software.

• Experience in the manufacture, wiring, testing, coordination of installation and commissioning of electrical equipment.

• Experience in diagnosing and resolving electrical or instrumentation faults in operational systems.

• Experience in preventive and corrective maintenance and in maintaining technical documentation and procedures.
Technical competencies:

• Design and modelling of low-voltage electrical circuits and networks.

• Design of electromechanical systems.

• Operation and maintenance of electromechanical equipment and systems.

• Knowledge and application of instrumentation and measurement techniques, ideally in a process or cryogenic environment.
Behavioural competencies:

• Managing Self: working well autonomously; taking on activities and tasks without prompting.

• Solving Problems: finding the information needed to solve problems; making objective judgements based on all the facts available.

• Communicating Effectively: delivering presentations in a structured and clear way; adjusting style and content to the audience; responding calmly and confidently to questions.

• Working in Teams: contributing to promoting a positive atmosphere in the team through an optimistic and constructive attitude; addressing issues.

• Learning and Sharing Knowledge: sharing knowledge and expertise freely and willingly with others; coaching others to ensure knowledge transfer.
Language skills:
Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 30.09.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
Employment Conditions
Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
This position involves:

• Participation in a regular stand-by duty, including nights, Sundays and official holidays.

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain conditions.

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job grade: 3-4
Job reference: TE-CRG-IC-2026-176-LD
Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Electromechanical Technician

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

descriptionByLocale.de:
Einleitung
Sie stellen die Verfügbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit der kryogenen Anlagen des CERN sicher, indem Sie täglich technischen Support anbieten, industrielle Messsysteme warten und komplexe elektrische Fehler diagnostizieren. Sie tragen auch zur Gestaltung und Optimierung von Niederspannungs-Elektroschränken und -komponenten unter Einhaltung der elektrischen Sicherheitsstandards bei.
Funktionen

• Beitrag zum technischen Entwurf und zur Entwicklung von Schaltschränken für kryogene Systeme, einschließlich der Berechnung zur Dimensionierung der elektrischen Systeme, Erstellung detaillierter elektrischer Zeichnungen, Auswahl der Komponenten und Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Anforderungen an die elektrische Sicherheit.

• Beteiligen Sie sich an und überwachen Sie die Herstellung, Installation und Inbetriebnahme von Elektro- und Instrumentensystemen für kryogene Anlagen, einschließlich der damit verbundenen Beschaffungsaktivitäten wie der Bewertung von Kostenschätzungen und der Bestellkomponente.

• Tägliche Betriebsunterstützung für kryogene Anlagen und Beitrag zum Bereitschaftsdienst zur Lösung dringender Probleme (einschließlich Fehlersuche, Implementierung von Korrekturen und Berichterstattung an das Betriebsteam).

• Planen und koordinieren Sie präventive und korrektive Wartungstätigkeiten für Systemkomponenten, legen Sie Wartungsprioritäten fest und halten Sie die entsprechenden technischen Unterlagen und Verfahren auf dem neuesten Stand.

• Wählen und implementieren Sie industrielle Instrumentierungssysteme und führen Sie Geräteprüfungen und -kalibrierungen gemäß den betrieblichen Anforderungen durch.

Technisches Zertifikat oder allgemeine Sekundarschulbildung oder gleichwertige einschlägige Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet der industriellen Elektrotechnik, Elektro- und Instrumententechnik, Elektromechanik oder einem verwandten Gebiet.

Erfahrung:

• Erfahrung in der Gestaltung von Niederspannungs-elektrischen Systemen und Schränken, einschließlich Systemarchitektur, Kabel- und Schutzgrößen, Geräteauswahl und Erstellung von Schaltplänen mit elektrischer SEE CAD-Software.

• Erfahrung in der Herstellung, Verkabelung, Prüfung, Koordination der Installation und Inbetriebnahme von elektrischen Geräten.

• Erfahrung in der Diagnose und Behebung von elektrischen oder Instrumentierungsfehlern in Betriebssystemen.

• Erfahrung in der präventiven und korrektiven Wartung und in der Pflege der technischen Dokumentation und Verfahren.
Technische Kompetenzen:

• Entwurf und Modellierung von Niederspannungsstromkreisen und -netzen.

• Entwurf elektromechanischer Systeme.

• Betrieb und Wartung von elektromechanischen Geräten und Systemen.

• Kenntnisse und Anwendung von Instrumentierungs- und Messtechniken, idealerweise in einer Prozess- oder kryogenen Umgebung.
Verhaltenskompetenzen:

• Selbstmanagement: gut autonom arbeiten; Aktivitäten und Aufgaben übernehmen, ohne zu veranlassen.

• Probleme lösen: die Informationen finden, die zur Lösung von Problemen benötigt werden; objektive Urteile auf der Grundlage aller verfügbaren Fakten treffen.

• Effektiv kommunizieren: Präsentationen auf strukturierte und klare Weise liefern; Stil und Inhalt an das Publikum anpassen; ruhig und selbstbewusst auf Fragen reagieren.

• Arbeiten in Teams: Beitrag zur Förderung einer positiven Atmosphäre im Team durch eine optimistische und konstruktive Haltung; Adressierung von Themen.

• Lernen und Teilen von Wissen: Wissen und Fachwissen frei und bereitwillig mit anderen teilen; andere coachen, um den Wissenstransfer zu gewährleisten.
Sprachkenntnisse:
Gesprochen und geschrieben Englisch oder Französisch, mit der Verpflichtung, die andere Sprache zu lernen.

Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein integraler Bestandteil der Mission des CERN und ist ein fester Wert der Organisation. Die Beschäftigung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft ist zentral für unseren Erfolg. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aus allen Mitgliedstaaten und assoziierten Mitgliedstaaten.
Diese freie Stelle wird so schnell wie möglich besetzt, und Anträge sollten uns normalerweise spätestens am 30.09.2026 um 23:59 Uhr MESZ erreichen.
Beschäftigungsbedingungen
Vertragsart: Befristeter Vertrag (5 Jahre). Unter bestimmten Bedingungen können Inhaber von befristeten Verträgen eine unbefristete Position beantragen.
Arbeitszeit: 40 Stunden pro Woche
Arbeitsplatzflexibilität: Vollständig vor Ort
Diese Position umfasst:

• Teilnahme an einem regulären Bereitschaftsdienst, einschließlich Nächten, Sonntagen und Feiertagen.

• Arbeiten in Strahlungsgebieten.

• Eingriffe in unterirdische Anlagen.

Globale Vorteile

Présentation
Vous assurerez la disponibilité et la fiabilité des installations cryogéniques du CERN en fournissant un support technique quotidien, en maintenant des systèmes d'instrumentation industrielle et en diagnosticant des défauts électriques complexes. Vous contribuerez également à la conception et à l'optimisation des armoires et composants électriques à basse tension, conformément aux normes de sécurité électrique.
Fonctions

• Contribuer à la conception et au développement techniques des armoires électriques pour les systèmes cryogéniques, y compris le calcul pour dimensionner les systèmes électriques, produire des dessins électriques détaillés, sélectionner les composants et assurer le respect des exigences de sécurité électrique.

• Participer et superviser la fabrication, l'installation et la mise en service de systèmes électriques et d'instruments pour les installations cryogéniques, y compris les activités d'approvisionnement connexes telles que l'évaluation des coûts estimatifs et de la composante commande.

• Fournir un soutien opérationnel quotidien aux installations cryogéniques et contribuer au service de réserve pour résoudre les problèmes urgents (y compris la recherche de la faute, la mise en place de correctifs et la présentation de rapports à l'équipe opérationnelle).

• Planifier et coordonner les activités de maintenance préventive et corrective des composantes du système, établir les priorités de maintenance et tenir à jour la documentation technique et les procédures correspondantes.

• Choisir et mettre en œuvre des systèmes d'instrumentation industrielle et effectuer les essais et l'étalonnage de l'équipement conformément aux exigences opérationnelles.

Certificat technique ou enseignement secondaire général ou expérience équivalente pertinente dans le domaine de l'électrotechnique industrielle, de l'électricité et de la technologie d'instrumentation, de l'électromécanique ou d'un domaine connexe.

Expérience :

• Expérience dans la conception de systèmes et d'armoires électriques à basse tension, y compris l'architecture du système, le calibrage des câbles et de la protection, le choix des appareils et la préparation des schémas de câblage, en utilisant le logiciel électrique VOIR CAO.

• Expérience dans la fabrication, le câblage, les essais, la coordination de l'installation et la mise en service d'équipements électriques.

• Expérience du diagnostic et de la résolution des défauts électriques ou instrumentaux dans les systèmes opérationnels.

• Expérience en maintenance préventive et corrective et en tenue à jour de la documentation et des procédures techniques.
Compétences techniques:

• Conception et modélisation de circuits et réseaux électriques à basse tension.

• Conception de systèmes électromécaniques.

• Fonctionnement et entretien des équipements et systèmes électromécaniques.

• Connaissance et application des techniques d'instrumentation et de mesure, idéalement dans un environnement de procédé ou cryogénique.
Compétences comportementales :

• Gérer soi : travailler bien de manière autonome; entreprendre des activités et des tâches sans enclencher.

• Résoudre les problèmes : trouver l'information nécessaire pour résoudre les problèmes; rendre des jugements objectifs fondés sur tous les faits disponibles.

• Communiquer efficacement : présenter des présentations de façon structurée et claire; adapter le style et le contenu au public; répondre calmement et avec confiance aux questions.

• Travailler en équipe : contribuer à promouvoir un climat positif au sein de l'équipe par une attitude optimiste et constructive; aborder les questions.

• Apprentissage et partage des connaissances : partage des connaissances et de l'expertise librement et volontairement avec les autres; coaching des autres pour assurer le transfert des connaissances.

Parlé et écrit anglais ou français, avec un engagement à apprendre l'autre langue.

jobs.description:
Job Overview:
 We are offering one post-doctoral research position in the field of applied physics and engineering. The successful candidates will be working in the Accelerator Systems departments of CERN. They will be performing research in the field of Accelerator Physics and System Design, including but not limited to:

- Design, develop and optimise beam transfer systems supporting CERN's accelerator complex and future accelerator projects.

- Perform accelerator physics studies, including beam optics design, particle tracking and multi-physics simulations, to support system design, validation and performance optimisation.

- Develop functional specifications for beam transfer systems based on accelerator physics requirements and engineering constraints.

- Develop and implement modern commissioning strategies using automation, numerical optimisation and data-driven techniques.

- Analyse beam and system performance to improve beam quality, operational efficiency and system reliability.
 Candidate Profile:

• You have a strong background in applied physics, engineering or a closely related field.

• You have research experience in applied physics and engineering, ideally linked to the design, development or operation of experimental systems.

• You are interested in pursuing a career in research or academia and in taking an active role within a research project.

• You are motivated to contribute to large-scale experimental programmes in an international research environment.
 Technical Skills:

• You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills applied to experimental systems and technologies.

• You are able to work collaboratively within large, international and multidisciplinary teams.

• You communicate effectively in a scientific and technical environment.

• You are able to work independently while contributing to shared project objectives.

• Your PhD is in the fields of Applied Physics and Engineering.

CERN would very much like to benefit from your expertise, commitment and passion. In return, CERN will provide you with:

• An employment contract for in principle 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months.

• A stipend of 7004 Swiss francs per month (net of tax).

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Depending on your individual circumstances: an installation grant, family, child and infant allowances as well as travel expenses to and from Geneva.

• 2.5 days of paid leave per month.
 Your future Life @CERN
 Get a glimpse of what it’s like to work at CERN:  https://careers.cern/benefits and https://careers.cern/our-people
 All applications should reach us no later than 05.10.2026  at midnight (23:59 PM CET).
 Please note that all the documents you upload will remain attached to your Smartrecruiters profile. You do not need to upload them again for other applications you might submit.

Global Benefits

• A monthly net stipend of either 7004 or 7425 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
 Be sure to meet the eligibility criteria

• You are a national of a  CERN Member State or Associate Member State . Currently, we cannot consider applications from Pakistani, Lithuanian, Latvian, Cypriot and Croatian nationals, as the ceiling defined under Article II.5 of the Associate Membership Agreement has been reached. A few exceptions are possible annually.

• By the application deadline, you have a PhD (or will obtain it within six months), and no more than 3 years’ research experience after completion of your PhD degree. Candidates with experience up to 6 years may exceptionally be considered.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• You have a good knowledge of English or French.

• Please pay attention to the additional criteria and requirements for this specific position and mentioned above.

• Please ensure that your application is submitted under the field of work indicated in the position title, as Experimental Physics, Applied Science and Engineering and Theoretical Physics are separate recruitment processes. All open positions within the programme are available on the  Research Fellowship Programme page .
 You will need these documents to complete your application

• Your CV (English or French)

• A copy of your most relevant diploma or a certificate of achievement from your school (if you don't yet have your paper diploma)

• Three recent letters of recommendation (not older than one year at the application deadline) outlining your academic and/or professional achievements, indicating the professional relationship from the referee to you. After submitting your application, you will receive a submission link to forward to your referees; letters must be uploaded confidentially before the closing date (uploading letters yourself is possible but discouraged).
 Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 More information about us, here

Stiamo offrendo una posizione di ricerca post-dottorale nel campo della fisica applicata e dell'ingegneria. I candidati di successo lavoreranno nei reparti Accelerator Systems del CERN. Saranno eseguendo la ricerca nel campo di Accelerator Physics e System Design, compreso ma non limitato a:

- Progettazione, sviluppo e ottimizzazione dei sistemi di trasferimento del fascio che supportano i progetti di acceleratore complessi e futuri del CERN.

- Esegui gli studi di fisica dell'acceleratore, tra cui la progettazione dell'ottica del fascio, il tracciamento delle particelle e le simulazioni multifisiche, per supportare la progettazione del sistema, la convalida e l'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni.

- Sviluppare specifiche funzionali per i sistemi di trasferimento del fascio in base ai requisiti di fisica dell'acceleratore e ai vincoli di ingegneria.

- Sviluppare e implementare moderne strategie di messa in servizio utilizzando l'automazione, l'ottimizzazione numerica e le tecniche data-driven.

- Analizzare le prestazioni del fascio e del sistema per migliorare la qualità del fascio, l'efficienza operativa e l'affidabilità del sistema.
Profilo del candidato:

• Hai un forte background in fisica applicata, ingegneria o un campo strettamente correlato.

• Hai esperienza di ricerca in fisica applicata e ingegneria, idealmente legata alla progettazione, sviluppo o funzionamento di sistemi sperimentali.

• Sei interessato a perseguire una carriera nella ricerca o nell'accademia e ad assumere un ruolo attivo all'interno di un progetto di ricerca.

• Sei motivato a contribuire a programmi sperimentali su larga scala in un ambiente di ricerca internazionale.
Competenze tecniche:

• Hai forti capacità analitiche e di problem solving applicate a sistemi e tecnologie sperimentali.

• Sei in grado di lavorare in collaborazione all'interno di team di grandi, internazionali e multidisciplinari.

• Si comunica efficacemente in un ambiente scientifico e tecnico.

• Siete in grado di lavorare in modo indipendente, contribuendo a obiettivi di progetto condivisi.

• Il vostro dottorato è nei campi della fisica applicata e dell'ingegneria.

Il CERN vorrebbe molto trarre beneficio dalla vostra competenza, impegno e passione. In cambio, il CERN vi fornirà:

• Un contratto di lavoro per principio 24 mesi, con una possibile proroga fino a 36 mesi.

• Contributo di 7004 franchi svizzeri al mese (net di imposta).

• Copertura del sistema sanitario completo del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli), e l'adesione al CERN Pension Fund.

• A seconda delle circostanze individuali: una sovvenzione di installazione, assegni familiari, bambini e bambini, nonché le spese di viaggio da e per Ginevra.

• 2.5 giorni di congedo retribuito al mese.
La tua vita futura @CERN
Dai un'occhiata a cosa si prova a lavorare al CERN: https://careers.cern/benefits e https://careers.cern/our-people
Tutte le applicazioni dovrebbero raggiungerci entro il 05.10.2026 a mezzanotte (23:59 PM CET).
Si prega di notare che tutti i documenti caricati rimangono attaccati al tuo profilo Smartrecruiters. Non è necessario caricarli di nuovo per altre applicazioni che potresti presentare.

Vantaggi globali

• Una spesa netta mensile di 7004 o 7425 franchi svizzeri al mese a seconda della laurea.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.

• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.

• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione e spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.

• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 36 mesi.

• On-the-job e formazione formale, comprese le lezioni di lingua.
Assicurarsi di soddisfare i criteri di ammissibilità

• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato . Attualmente, non possiamo considerare le domande dei cittadini pakistano, lituano, lettone, cipriota e croato, come è stato raggiunto il massimale definito a norma dell'articolo II.5 dell'accordo di associazione. Alcune eccezioni sono possibili annualmente.

• Con la scadenza della domanda, si dispone di un PhD (o lo otterrà entro sei mesi), e non più di 3 anni di esperienza di ricerca dopo il completamento del dottorato di ricerca. I candidati con esperienza fino a 6 anni possono essere considerati eccezionalmente.

• Non hai mai avuto un contratto di laurea o di socio del CERN.

• Hai una buona conoscenza di inglese o francese.

• Si prega di prestare attenzione ai criteri e ai requisiti aggiuntivi per questa specifica posizione e menzionato sopra.

• Si prega di assicurarsi che la vostra domanda sia presentata sotto il campo di lavoro indicato nel titolo di posizione, come fisica sperimentale, scienza applicata e ingegneria e fisica teorica sono processi di reclutamento separati. Tutte le posizioni aperte all'interno del programma sono disponibili nella pagina del programma di ricerca Fellowship .
Avrete bisogno di questi documenti per completare la vostra applicazione

• Il tuo CV (inglese o francese)

• Una copia del vostro diploma più rilevante o un certificato di successo dalla vostra scuola (se non avete ancora il diploma di carta)

• Tre recenti lettere di raccomandazione (non più di un anno al termine della domanda) che delineano i vostri risultati accademici e/o professionali, indicando il rapporto professionale dall'arbitro a voi. Dopo aver presentato la tua domanda, riceverai un link di presentazione per inoltrare i tuoi arbitri; le lettere devono essere caricate confidenziali prima della data di chiusura (il caricamento delle lettere è possibile ma scoraggiato).
Scoprite un mondo dove l'impossibile è reso possibile!

descriptionByLocale.en:
Job Overview:
We are offering one post-doctoral research position in the field of applied physics and engineering. The successful candidates will be working in the Accelerator Systems departments of CERN. They will be performing research in the field of Accelerator Physics and System Design, including but not limited to:

- Design, develop and optimise beam transfer systems supporting CERN's accelerator complex and future accelerator projects.

- Perform accelerator physics studies, including beam optics design, particle tracking and multi-physics simulations, to support system design, validation and performance optimisation.

- Develop functional specifications for beam transfer systems based on accelerator physics requirements and engineering constraints.

- Develop and implement modern commissioning strategies using automation, numerical optimisation and data-driven techniques.

- Analyse beam and system performance to improve beam quality, operational efficiency and system reliability.
Candidate Profile:

• You have a strong background in applied physics, engineering or a closely related field.

• You have research experience in applied physics and engineering, ideally linked to the design, development or operation of experimental systems.

• You are interested in pursuing a career in research or academia and in taking an active role within a research project.

• You are motivated to contribute to large-scale experimental programmes in an international research environment.
Technical Skills:

• You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills applied to experimental systems and technologies.

• You are able to work collaboratively within large, international and multidisciplinary teams.

• You communicate effectively in a scientific and technical environment.

• You are able to work independently while contributing to shared project objectives.

• Your PhD is in the fields of Applied Physics and Engineering.

CERN would very much like to benefit from your expertise, commitment and passion. In return, CERN will provide you with:

• An employment contract for in principle 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months.

• A stipend of 7004 Swiss francs per month (net of tax).

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Depending on your individual circumstances: an installation grant, family, child and infant allowances as well as travel expenses to and from Geneva.

• 2.5 days of paid leave per month.
Your future Life @CERN
Get a glimpse of what it’s like to work at CERN:  https://careers.cern/benefits and https://careers.cern/our-people
All applications should reach us no later than 05.10.2026  at midnight (23:59 PM CET).
Please note that all the documents you upload will remain attached to your Smartrecruiters profile. You do not need to upload them again for other applications you might submit.

Global Benefits

• A monthly net stipend of either 7004 or 7425 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Be sure to meet the eligibility criteria

• You are a national of a  CERN Member State or Associate Member State . Currently, we cannot consider applications from Pakistani, Lithuanian, Latvian, Cypriot and Croatian nationals, as the ceiling defined under Article II.5 of the Associate Membership Agreement has been reached. A few exceptions are possible annually.

• By the application deadline, you have a PhD (or will obtain it within six months), and no more than 3 years’ research experience after completion of your PhD degree. Candidates with experience up to 6 years may exceptionally be considered.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• You have a good knowledge of English or French.

• Please pay attention to the additional criteria and requirements for this specific position and mentioned above.

• Please ensure that your application is submitted under the field of work indicated in the position title, as Experimental Physics, Applied Science and Engineering and Theoretical Physics are separate recruitment processes. All open positions within the programme are available on the  Research Fellowship Programme page .
You will need these documents to complete your application

• Your CV (English or French)

• A copy of your most relevant diploma or a certificate of achievement from your school (if you don't yet have your paper diploma)

• Three recent letters of recommendation (not older than one year at the application deadline) outlining your academic and/or professional achievements, indicating the professional relationship from the referee to you. After submitting your application, you will receive a submission link to forward to your referees; letters must be uploaded confidentially before the closing date (uploading letters yourself is possible but discouraged).
Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
More information about us, here
descriptionByLocale.de:
Stellenübersicht:
Wir bieten eine Postdoktorandenstelle im Bereich der angewandten Physik und Technik an. Die erfolgreichen Kandidaten werden in den Accelerator Systems Abteilungen des CERN arbeiten. Sie werden Forschung auf dem Gebiet der Beschleunigungsphysik und des Systemdesigns durchführen, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf:

- Entwurf, Entwicklung und Optimierung von Strahlübertragungssystemen, die den CERN-Beschleunigerkomplex und zukünftige Beschleunigerprojekte unterstützen.

- Durchführung von Beschleunigerphysikstudien, einschließlich Strahloptik-Design, Partikelverfolgung und Multiphysik-Simulationen zur Unterstützung des Systemdesigns, der Validierung und der Leistungsoptimierung.

- Entwicklung funktioneller Spezifikationen für Strahlübertragungssysteme auf der Grundlage von Beschleunigerphysikanforderungen und technischen Einschränkungen.

- Entwickeln und implementieren Sie moderne Inbetriebnahmestrategien mit Automatisierung, numerischer Optimierung und datengesteuerten Techniken.

- Analyse der Strahl- und Systemleistung zur Verbesserung der Strahlqualität, der Betriebseffizienz und der Systemzuverlässigkeit.
Bewerberprofil:

• Sie haben einen starken Hintergrund in angewandter Physik, Ingenieurwesen oder einem eng verwandten Bereich.

• Sie haben Forschungserfahrung in angewandter Physik und Ingenieurwissenschaften, die idealerweise mit dem Entwurf, der Entwicklung oder dem Betrieb von experimentellen Systemen verbunden sind.

• Sie sind daran interessiert, eine Karriere in der Forschung oder Wissenschaft zu verfolgen und eine aktive Rolle in einem Forschungsprojekt zu übernehmen.

• Sie sind motiviert, zu groß angelegten experimentellen Programmen in einem internationalen Forschungsumfeld beizutragen.
Technische Fähigkeiten:

• Sie verfügen über starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten, die auf experimentelle Systeme und Technologien angewendet werden.

• Sie können in großen, internationalen und multidisziplinären Teams zusammenarbeiten.

• Sie kommunizieren effektiv in einem wissenschaftlichen und technischen Umfeld.

• Sie können unabhängig arbeiten und gleichzeitig zu gemeinsamen Projektzielen beitragen.

• Ihre PhD ist in den Bereichen Angewandte Physik und Ingenieurwissenschaften.

CERN möchte sehr gerne von Ihrer Expertise, Ihrem Engagement und Ihrer Leidenschaft profitieren. Im Gegenzug bietet Ihnen CERN:

• Ein Arbeitsvertrag für grundsätzlich 24 Monate, mit einer möglichen Verlängerung bis zu 36 Monaten.

• Ein Stipendium von 7004 Schweizer Franken pro Monat (abzüglich Steuern).

• Abdeckung durch das umfassende Gesundheitssystem des CERN (für Sie, Ihren Ehepartner und Ihre Kinder) und die Mitgliedschaft in der CERN-Pensionskasse.

• Abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen: ein Installationszuschuss, Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen sowie Reisekosten von und nach Genf.

• 2,5 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Monat.
Dein zukünftiges Leben @CERN
Erfahren Sie, wie es ist, am CERN zu arbeiten: https://careers.cern/benefits und https://careers.cern/our-people
Alle Anträge sollten uns spätestens am 05.10.2026 um Mitternacht (23:59 Uhr MEZ) erreichen.
Bitte beachten Sie, dass alle Dokumente, die Sie hochladen, Ihrem Smartrecruiters-Profil beigefügt bleiben. Sie müssen sie nicht erneut für andere Anwendungen hochladen, die Sie möglicherweise einreichen.

Globale Vorteile

• Ein monatliches Nettostipendium von entweder 7004 oder 7425 Schweizer Franken pro Monat, abhängig von Ihrem Abschluss.

• 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr plus 2 Wochen jährliche Schließung.

• Deckung durch die umfassende Krankenversicherung des CERN (für Sie, Ihren Ehepartner und Ihre Kinder) und die Mitgliedschaft in der CERN-Pensionskasse.

• Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen, abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Ein Umzugspaket (Installationszuschuss und Reisekosten), abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Möglichkeit, Ihren Vertrag bis zu 36 Monate zu verlängern.

• On-the-job und formale Ausbildung einschließlich Sprachunterricht.
Achten Sie darauf, die Förderkriterien zu erfüllen

• Sie sind Staatsangehöriger eines CERN-Mitgliedstaats oder assoziierten Mitgliedstaats. Derzeit können wir keine Anträge von pakistanischen, litauischen, lettischen, zypriotischen und kroatischen Staatsangehörigen berücksichtigen, da die in Artikel II.5 des assoziierten Beitrittsabkommens festgelegte Obergrenze erreicht wurde. Einige Ausnahmen sind jährlich möglich.

• Bis zum Bewerbungsschluss haben Sie einen PhD (oder erhalten ihn innerhalb von sechs Monaten) und nicht mehr als 3 Jahre Forschungserfahrung nach Abschluss Ihres PhD-Abschlusses. Kandidaten mit Erfahrung bis zu 6 Jahren können ausnahmsweise in Betracht gezogen werden.

• Sie hatten noch nie einen CERN-Stipendiaten- oder Absolventenvertrag.

• Sie haben gute Englisch- oder Französischkenntnisse.

• Bitte beachten Sie die zusätzlichen Kriterien und Anforderungen für diese spezifische Position und oben erwähnt.

• Bitte stellen Sie sicher, dass Ihre Bewerbung unter dem in der Positionsbezeichnung angegebenen Arbeitsbereich eingereicht wird, da Experimentalphysik, Angewandte Technik und Theoretische Physik separate Rekrutierungsprozesse sind. Alle offenen Stellen innerhalb des Programms sind auf der Seite des Forschungsstipendiums verfügbar.
Sie benötigen diese Dokumente, um Ihre Bewerbung abzuschließen

• Ihr Lebenslauf (Englisch oder Französisch)

• Eine Kopie Ihres wichtigsten Diploms oder eine Leistungsbescheinigung Ihrer Schule (wenn Sie noch kein Papierdiplom haben)

• Drei aktuelle Empfehlungsschreiben (nicht älter als ein Jahr zum Bewerbungsschluss), in denen Ihre akademischen und / oder beruflichen Leistungen dargelegt werden und die berufliche Beziehung des Schiedsrichters zu Ihnen angegeben wird. Nachdem Sie Ihre Bewerbung eingereicht haben, erhalten Sie einen Einreichungslink zur Weiterleitung an Ihre Schiedsrichter; Briefe müssen vor dem Abschlussdatum vertraulich hochgeladen werden (das Hochladen von Briefen selbst ist möglich, aber entmutigt).

Aperçu de l'emploi :
Nous offrons un poste de recherche postdoctorale dans le domaine de la physique appliquée et du génie. Les candidats retenus travailleront dans les départements Accelerator Systems du CERN. Ils effectueront des recherches dans le domaine de la physique de l'accélérateur et de la conception du système, notamment :

- Concevoir, développer et optimiser des systèmes de transfert de faisceau pour soutenir les projets d'accélérateurs complexes et futurs du CERN.

- Effectuer des études de physique de l'accélérateur, y compris la conception de faisceaux optiques, le suivi des particules et des simulations multiphysiques, pour soutenir la conception, la validation et l'optimisation des performances du système.

- Élaborer des spécifications fonctionnelles pour les systèmes de transfert de faisceau en fonction des exigences de physique des accélérateurs et des contraintes techniques.

- Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de mise en service modernes utilisant l'automatisation, l'optimisation numérique et les techniques fondées sur les données.

- Analyser les performances du faisceau et du système pour améliorer la qualité du faisceau, son efficacité opérationnelle et sa fiabilité.
Profil du candidat :

• Vous avez une solide expérience en physique appliquée, en ingénierie ou dans un domaine étroitement lié.

• Vous avez une expérience de recherche en physique appliquée et en ingénierie, idéalement liée à la conception, au développement ou au fonctionnement de systèmes expérimentaux.

• Vous êtes intéressé à poursuivre une carrière en recherche ou en milieu universitaire et à jouer un rôle actif dans un projet de recherche.

• Vous êtes motivé à contribuer à des programmes expérimentaux à grande échelle dans un environnement de recherche international.
Compétences techniques :

• Vous avez de solides compétences analytiques et de résolution de problèmes appliquées aux systèmes et technologies expérimentaux.

• Vous pouvez travailler en collaboration au sein de grandes équipes internationales et multidisciplinaires.

• Vous communiquez efficacement dans un environnement scientifique et technique.

• Vous êtes en mesure de travailler de façon indépendante tout en contribuant aux objectifs communs du projet.

• Votre doctorat est dans les domaines de la physique appliquée et de l'ingénierie.

Le CERN aimerait beaucoup bénéficier de votre expertise, de votre engagement et de votre passion. En échange, le CERN vous fournira :

• Un contrat de travail en principe de 24 mois, avec une prolongation possible de 36 mois.

• Une allocation de 7004 francs suisses par mois (hors taxes).

• Couverture par le CERN (pour vous-même, votre conjoint et vos enfants) et affiliation à la Caisse de retraite du CERN.

• En fonction de votre situation personnelle : prime d'installation, allocations familiales, allocations pour enfants et enfants ainsi que frais de voyage à destination et en provenance de Genève.

jobs.title: Mechanical CAD Designer (TE-MSC-SMT-2026-195-LD)
jobs.description:
Introduction
 As a Mechanical CAD Designer in the Superconducting Magnet Technology section, you will develop three-dimensional computer-aided design (CAD) models and detailed drawings for novel superconducting magnets and associated tooling. Working closely with engineers and other technical specialists, you will take part in research and development projects for future particle accelerators. Your work will help transform innovative magnet concepts into manufacturable prototypes and practical assembly solutions.
 Functions

• Prepare 3D CAD mechanical models and drawings of short magnet demonstrators, prototypes and associated tooling, in close collaboration with other colleagues in the section.

• Update CAD models and drawings to integrate feedback from construction and assembly activities.

• Contribute to technical discussions related to mechanical tolerances, machining methods and assembly procedures.

• Support procurement of components and update CAD models and drawings to reflect as-built configurations.

• Assist colleagues with tailored 3D models for computer numerical control (CNC) machining and simulations (electromagnetic, mechanical).

Higher technical diploma or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Experience:

• Proficiency in CATIA (or a similar modern 3D CAD software), including the production of detailed 2D manufacturing and assembly drawings, for mechanical components and assemblies.

• Experience with a Product Lifecycle Management database (e.g. PLM, Enovia, SmarTeam) to manage models and drawings.

• Knowledge of mechanical assemblies and ISO-GPS dimensioning and tolerancing.

• Knowledge of superconducting magnet construction and technologies would be an asset.
 Technical competencies:

• Knowledge and application of manufacturing methods and work preparation.

• Assembly of mechanical structures and equipment.

• Production of 2D drawings and 3D models.

• Knowledge and application of mechanical measurement techniques.
 Behavioural competencies:

• Working in Teams: working well in groups and readily fitting into a team; participating fully and taking an active role in team activities.

• Demonstrating Accountability: working conscientiously and reliably; delivering on promises.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: adapting quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.

• Learning and Sharing Knowledge: sharing knowledge and expertise freely and willingly with others.
 Language skills:
 Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Eligibility and closing date:
 Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
 This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 14.10.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
 Employment Conditions
 Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
 Working Hours: 40 hours per week
 Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
 This position involves:

• A valid driving licence.

• Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.
 Job grade: 3-4
 Job reference: TE-MSC-SMT-2026-195-LD
 Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
 Benchmark Job Title: Mechanical Technician

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione
Come progettista meccanico CAD nella sezione Superconducting Magnet Technology, svilupperai modelli di progettazione computerizzata tridimensionale (CAD) e disegni dettagliati per nuovi magneti superconduttori e utensili associati. Lavorando a stretto contatto con ingegneri e altri specialisti tecnici, parteciperai a progetti di ricerca e sviluppo per futuri acceleratori di particelle. Il vostro lavoro contribuirà a trasformare concetti magneti innovativi in prototipi manifatturieri e soluzioni pratiche di montaggio.
Funzioni

• Prepara modelli meccanici 3D CAD e disegni di dimostranti a magnete corto, prototipi e utensili associati, in stretta collaborazione con altri colleghi della sezione.

• Aggiorna modelli CAD e disegni per integrare il feedback dalle attività di costruzione e montaggio.

• Contribuire a discussioni tecniche relative a tolleranze meccaniche, metodi di lavorazione e procedure di montaggio.

• Supporta l'approvvigionamento di componenti e aggiorna modelli e disegni CAD per riflettere configurazioni integrate.

• Assist i colleghi con modelli 3D su misura per la lavorazione e le simulazioni di controllo numerico del computer (CNC) (elettromagnetico, meccanico).

Più alto diploma tecnico o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo dell'ingegneria meccanica o un campo correlato.

Esperienza:

• Proficienza in CATIA (o un software CAD 3D simile), compresa la produzione di disegni di produzione e montaggio in 2D dettagliati, per componenti e assemblaggi meccanici.

• Esperienza con un database Product Lifecycle Management (ad esempio PLM, Enovia, SmarTeam) per gestire modelli e disegni.

• Conoscenza degli assemblaggi meccanici e dimensionamento e toleranziamento ISO-GPS.

• La conoscenza della costruzione e delle tecnologie dei magneti superconduttori sarebbe un bene.
Competenze tecniche:

• Conoscenza e applicazione dei metodi di fabbricazione e preparazione del lavoro.

• Montaggio di strutture meccaniche e attrezzature.

• Produzione di disegni 2D e modelli 3D.

• Conoscenza e applicazione delle tecniche di misura meccanica.
Competenze comportamentali:

• Lavorare in team: lavorare bene in gruppi e adattarsi prontamente a un team; partecipare pienamente e assumere un ruolo attivo nelle attività del team.

• Dimostrare la Responsabilità: lavorare in modo cosciente e affidabile; fornire promesse.

• Dimostrare Flessibilità: adattare rapidamente e con risorse a spostare le priorità e i requisiti.

• Conoscenza e condivisione: condividere conoscenze e competenze liberamente e volentieri con gli altri.
Capacità linguistiche:
Parlato e scritto inglese o francese, con un impegno per imparare l'altra lingua.

Ammissibilità e chiusura:
La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati.
Questa vacanza sarà riempita il più presto possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 14.10.2026 a 23:59 CEST .
Condizioni di lavoro
Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (5 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato.
Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana
Flessibilità del lavoro: completamente in loco
Questa posizione comporta:

• Una patente di guida valida.

• In piedi, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione.
Grado di lavoro: 3-4
Riferimento del lavoro: TE-MSC-SMT-2026-195-LD
Campo di lavoro: Ingegneria meccanica
Benchmark Titolo del lavoro: Tecnico meccanico

Vantaggi globali

• Uno stipendio competitivo (gratuito fiscale), in linea con gli anni di esperienza rilevante.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.

• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.

• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione, rimozione, spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.

• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 8 anni + ammissibilità per un periodo di tempo indeterminato.
Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile!
Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano.
Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo.
Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita!
Maggiori informazioni su di noi, qui: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction
As a Mechanical CAD Designer in the Superconducting Magnet Technology section, you will develop three-dimensional computer-aided design (CAD) models and detailed drawings for novel superconducting magnets and associated tooling. Working closely with engineers and other technical specialists, you will take part in research and development projects for future particle accelerators. Your work will help transform innovative magnet concepts into manufacturable prototypes and practical assembly solutions.
Functions

• Prepare 3D CAD mechanical models and drawings of short magnet demonstrators, prototypes and associated tooling, in close collaboration with other colleagues in the section.

• Update CAD models and drawings to integrate feedback from construction and assembly activities.

• Contribute to technical discussions related to mechanical tolerances, machining methods and assembly procedures.

• Support procurement of components and update CAD models and drawings to reflect as-built configurations.

• Assist colleagues with tailored 3D models for computer numerical control (CNC) machining and simulations (electromagnetic, mechanical).

Higher technical diploma or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Experience:

• Proficiency in CATIA (or a similar modern 3D CAD software), including the production of detailed 2D manufacturing and assembly drawings, for mechanical components and assemblies.

• Experience with a Product Lifecycle Management database (e.g. PLM, Enovia, SmarTeam) to manage models and drawings.

• Knowledge of mechanical assemblies and ISO-GPS dimensioning and tolerancing.

• Knowledge of superconducting magnet construction and technologies would be an asset.
Technical competencies:

• Knowledge and application of manufacturing methods and work preparation.

• Assembly of mechanical structures and equipment.

• Production of 2D drawings and 3D models.

• Knowledge and application of mechanical measurement techniques.
Behavioural competencies:

• Working in Teams: working well in groups and readily fitting into a team; participating fully and taking an active role in team activities.

• Demonstrating Accountability: working conscientiously and reliably; delivering on promises.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: adapting quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.

• Learning and Sharing Knowledge: sharing knowledge and expertise freely and willingly with others.
Language skills:
Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 14.10.2026 at 23:59 CEST .

Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.

Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
This position involves:

• A valid driving licence.

• Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Job grade: 3-4
Job reference: TE-MSC-SMT-2026-195-LD
Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Mechanical Technician

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

Als mechanischer CAD-Designer im Bereich Supraleitende Magnettechnologie entwickeln Sie dreidimensionale CAD-Modelle und detaillierte Zeichnungen für neuartige supraleitende Magnete und zugehörige Werkzeuge. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Ingenieuren und anderen technischen Spezialisten nehmen Sie an Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekten für zukünftige Teilchenbeschleuniger teil. Ihre Arbeit wird dazu beitragen, innovative Magnetkonzepte in herstellbare Prototypen und praktische Montagelösungen umzuwandeln.
Funktionen

• Bereiten Sie mechanische 3D-CAD-Modelle und Zeichnungen von Kurzmagnetdemonstratoren, Prototypen und zugehörigen Werkzeugen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Kollegen in der Sektion vor.

• Aktualisieren Sie CAD-Modelle und Zeichnungen, um Feedback aus Bau- und Montageaktivitäten zu integrieren.

• Beitrag zu technischen Diskussionen über mechanische Toleranzen, Bearbeitungsverfahren und Montageverfahren.

• Unterstützen Sie die Beschaffung von Komponenten und aktualisieren Sie CAD-Modelle und Zeichnungen, um eingebaute Konfigurationen widerzuspiegeln.

• Unterstützen Sie Kollegen mit maßgeschneiderten 3D-Modellen für die Bearbeitung von Computern zur numerischen Steuerung (CNC) und Simulationen (elektromagnetisch, mechanisch).

Höheres technisches Diplom oder gleichwertige einschlägige Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet des Maschinenbaus oder eines verwandten Gebiets.

Erfahrung:

• Kenntnisse in CATIA (oder einer ähnlichen modernen 3D-CAD-Software), einschließlich der Erstellung detaillierter 2D-Herstellungs- und Montagezeichnungen für mechanische Komponenten und Baugruppen.

• Erfahrung mit einer Product Lifecycle Management Datenbank (z. B. PLM, Enovia, SmarTeam) zur Verwaltung von Modellen und Zeichnungen.

• Kenntnisse über mechanische Baugruppen und ISO-GPS Dimensionierung und Tolerierung.

• Wissen über supraleitende Magnetkonstruktion und Technologien wäre ein Gewinn.

• Kenntnisse und Anwendung von Herstellungsmethoden und Arbeitsvorbereitung.

• Montage von mechanischen Strukturen und Ausrüstung.

• Herstellung von 2D-Zeichnungen und 3D-Modellen.

• Kenntnisse und Anwendung von mechanischen Messtechniken.
Verhaltenskompetenzen:

• Nachweis der Rechenschaftspflicht: gewissenhaft und zuverlässig arbeiten; Versprechen halten.

• Flexibilität demonstrieren: schnelle und einfallsreiche Anpassung an sich verändernde Prioritäten und Anforderungen.

• Lernen und Teilen von Wissen: Wissen und Fachwissen frei und bereitwillig mit anderen teilen.
Sprachkenntnisse:
Gesprochen und geschrieben Englisch oder Französisch, mit der Verpflichtung, die andere Sprache zu lernen.

Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein integraler Bestandteil der Mission des CERN und ist ein fester Wert der Organisation. Die Beschäftigung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft ist zentral für unseren Erfolg. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aus allen Mitgliedstaaten und assoziierten Mitgliedstaaten.

Job Grade: 3-4

jobs.description:
Join the team responsible for the High Throughput Compute systems at the heart of CERN's data processing!

Are you a recent graduate with an interest in large-scale computing, automation, and infrastructure technologies? Would you like to develop your skills while contributing to the evolution of the computing infrastructure supporting the High-Luminosity LHC?

As a member of the team responsible for the batch service and configuration management of IT services, you will have the opportunity to experience a varied role, from helping to automate the delivery of compute, to self healing infrastructure, to evolving the toolset that the IT department uses to manage its services.

The Compute and Devices (CD) group in CERN IT provides a wide range of compute services, all the way from end user devices, through cloud infrastructure-as-a- Service, machine-learning, Kubernetes, configuration management, batch and HPC computing at CERN, together with a set of services that support the whole WLCG.

As a member of the Compute and Configuration (CC) section of the CD group, you will join a team of engineers focusing on services supporting the physics community. We run the compute facility that comprises approximately 20% of the WLCG, using tools such as Puppet, OpenStack and Kubernetes to manage batch systems running HTCondor, HPC systems running SLURM, and the support services keeping everything glued together.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, contributing to open-source software, and working with infrastructure at scale, come join us!
 Your responsibilities

• Help manage the fleet of 400k+ cores complete lifecycle from CI provisioning through automated and AI enhanced maintenance.

• Help keep us ahead of LLM enhanced security threats with monitoring.

• Suggest, test, and deploy configuration changes on a large scale to production.

• Contribute to the operation and maintenance of the current configuration management infrastructure, including Foreman, Puppet and OpenVox components.

• Contribute to the development and maintenance of Terraform/OpenTofu modules used to provision and configure the supporting infrastructure.

• Improve the quality of the configuration code through testing, validation, code review and standardisation.
 Your profile

• Experience administering or working with Linux systems in a server or data centre environment.

• Experience writing scripts or applications for automation or system tasks.

• Experience with configuration management tools such as Puppet or Ansible is a plus.

• Experience with container technologies, CI/CD systems or Infrastructure-as-Code tools is a plus.
 Skills

• Knowledge of Linux, programming or scripting languages such as Python or Go.

• Familiarity with git for distributed version control is highly desirable.

• Knowledge of configuration management tools such as Puppet or Ansible is desirable.

• Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or OpenTofu would be a plus.

• Any knowledge of batch systems such as HTCondor, SLURM or kueue would be a plus.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Computer Science (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants without University degree are not eligible.

• Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

Job closing date: 08.10.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Hybrid
 Target start date: 01-December-2026
 This position involves:

• Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
 Job reference: IT-CD-CC-2026-223-GRAE
 Field of work: Information Technologies
 Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer

Global Benefits
